sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE unavail_places ( file_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE (file_id) ON CONFLICT IGNORE ); CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW used_places AS SELECT file_id, folder_kind FROM places WHERE level = 0 UNION SELECT file_id, 13 FROM unavail_places UNION SELECT file_id, 10 FROM files WHERE name = '<plugins>' UNION SELECT file_id, 14 FROM files WHERE name = '<keywords>' UNION SELECT file_id, 15 FROM files WHERE name = '<packs>';
CREATE TABLE plugin_modules ( module_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, path TEXT, arch INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );
CREATE TABLE plugin_domains ( id TEXT, module_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );

CREATE TABLE plugins ( plugin_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, module_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, dev_identifier TEXT, name TEXT, vendor TEXT, version TEXT, device_type TEXT, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );
ALTER TABLE plugin_modules ADD COLUMN fingerprint TEXT;

CREATE TABLE _tmpplugins ( plugin_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, module_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, dev_identifier TEXT, name TEXT, vendor TEXT, version TEXT, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0 ); INSERT INTO _tmpplugins (plugin_id, module_id, dev_identifier, name, vendor, version, scanstate, enabled) SELECT p.plugin_id, p.module_id, p.dev_identifier, p.name, p.vendor, p.version, p.scanstate, p.enabled FROM plugins AS p; DROP TABLE plugins; ALTER TABLE _tmpplugins RENAME TO plugins;
ALTER TABLE plugin_domains ADD COLUMN relpath TEXT;
ALTER TABLE plugins ADD COLUMN sdk_version TEXT; ALTER TABLE plugins ADD COLUMN flags INTEGER DEFAULT 0;

CREATE TABLE _tmpplugins ( plugin_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, module_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, dev_identifier TEXT, name TEXT, vendor TEXT, version TEXT, sdk_version TEXT, flags INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0 ); INSERT INTO _tmpplugins (plugin_id, module_id, dev_identifier, name, vendor, version, sdk_version, flags, scanstate, enabled) SELECT plugin_id, module_id, dev_identifier, name, vendor, version, sdk_version, flags, scanstate, enabled FROM plugins; DROP TABLE plugins; ALTER TABLE _tmpplugins RENAME TO plugins;

CREATE TABLE _tmp_plugin_modules ( module_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, path TEXT, arch INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, fingerprint TEXT ); INSERT INTO _tmp_plugin_modules (module_id, path, arch, scanstate, fingerprint) SELECT module_id, path, arch, scanstate, fingerprint FROM plugin_modules; DROP TABLE plugin_modules; ALTER TABLE _tmp_plugin_modules RENAME TO plugin_modules;
ALTER TABLE plugin_modules ADD COLUMN processor INTEGER DEFAULT 0;
DELETE FROM plugin_domains
ALTER TABLE plugins ADD COLUMN subcategories TEXT;
DROP TABLE plugins; DROP TABLE plugin_modules; DROP TABLE plugin_domains;

UPDATE plugins SET dev_identifier = :devid, name = :name, version = :version, vendor = :vendor, sdk_version = :sdkversion, scanstate = 1, flags = :flags, subcategories = :subcategories WHERE plugin_id = :plugin_id

SELECT pm.module_id, pd.id = :domain_id, pd.relpath, pm.scanstate FROM plugin_modules AS pm JOIN plugin_domains as pd ON (pm.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pm.path = :path AND pd.id = :domain_id AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0
INSERT INTO plugin_domains (id, module_id, relpath, enabled) VALUES (:id, :module_id, :relpath, 1)
INSERT INTO plugin_modules (path, arch, scanstate, fingerprint, processor) VALUES (:path, :arch, :scanstate, :fingerprint, :processor)
INSERT INTO plugin_modules (module_id, path, arch, scanstate, fingerprint, processor) VALUES (:module_id, :path, :arch, :scanstate, :fingerprint, :processor)
INSERT INTO plugins (module_id, name, scanstate) VALUES (:module_id, :name, :scanstate)

INSERT INTO plugins (plugin_id, module_id, dev_identifier, name, vendor, version, sdk_version, flags, scanstate, enabled, subcategories) VALUES (:plugin_id, :module_id, :devid, :name, :vendor, :version, :sdkversion, :flags, :scanstate, :enabled, :subcategories)
SELECT id, module_id, relpath, enabled FROM plugin_domains
SELECT module_id, path, arch, processor, scanstate, fingerprint FROM plugin_modules
SELECT plugin_id, module_id, dev_identifier, name, vendor, version, sdk_version, flags, scanstate, subcategories, enabled FROM plugins

SELECT p.plugin_id, p.module_id, pm.path, pd.relpath, p.name, p.vendor, p.scanstate, p.version, p.sdk_version, p.dev_identifier, p.enabled, pd.id, p.flags, pm.processor, p.subcategories FROM plugins AS p JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON (p.module_id = pm.module_id) JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (p.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pm.module_id = :module_id

SELECT pm.module_id, pm.path, pd.relpath, pm.scanstate, pd.id, pm.fingerprint, pm.processor FROM plugin_modules AS pm JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (pm.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pm.arch = :arch AND pd.id = :domain_id AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0
DELETE FROM plugins
DELETE FROM plugin_domains WHERE module_id = :module_id AND id = :domain_id
DELETE FROM plugin_modules WHERE module_id IN (SELECT pm.module_id FROM plugin_modules AS pm LEFT JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (pd.module_id = pm.module_id) WHERE pd.id IS NULL)
DELETE FROM plugins WHERE plugin_id IN (SELECT p.plugin_id FROM plugins AS p LEFT JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON (p.module_id = pm.module_id) WHERE pm.module_id IS NULL)
DELETE FROM plugin_domains WHERE module_id IN (SELECT pm.module_id FROM plugin_modules AS pm WHERE pm.arch = :arch AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0) AND id = :domain_id
DELETE FROM plugins WHERE module_id = :module_id

SELECT p.plugin_id, p.module_id, pm.path, pd.relpath, p.name, p.vendor, p.scanstate, p.version, p.sdk_version, p.dev_identifier, p.enabled, pd.id, p.flags, pm.processor, p.subcategories FROM plugins AS p JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON (p.module_id = pm.module_id) JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (p.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pd.enabled = 1 AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0

SELECT p.plugin_id, p.module_id, pm.path, pd.relpath, p.name, p.vendor, p.scanstate, p.version, p.sdk_version, p.dev_identifier, p.enabled, pd.id, p.flags, pm.processor, p.subcategories FROM plugins AS p JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON (p.module_id = pm.module_id) JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (p.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pm.arch = :arch AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0 AND pd.enabled = 1

SELECT p.plugin_id, p.module_id, pm.path, pd.relpath, p.name, p.vendor, p.scanstate, p.version, p.sdk_version, p.dev_identifier, p.enabled, pd.id, p.flags, pm.processor, p.subcategories FROM plugins AS p JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON (p.module_id = pm.module_id) JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (p.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pd.enabled = 1

SELECT p.plugin_id, p.module_id, pm.path, pd.relpath, p.name, p.vendor, p.scanstate, p.version, p.sdk_version, p.dev_identifier, p.enabled, pd.id, p.flags, pm.processor, p.subcategories FROM plugins AS p JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON (p.module_id = pm.module_id) JOIN plugin_domains AS pd ON (p.module_id = pd.module_id) WHERE pm.arch = :arch AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0 AND pd.enabled = 1 AND pm.scanstate = 1 AND p.scanstate = 1

UPDATE plugin_domains SET enabled = :enabled WHERE id = :domain_id AND module_id IN (SELECT pm.module_id FROM plugin_domains AS pd JOIN plugin_modules AS pm ON pd.module_id = pm.module_id WHERE pm.arch = :arch AND pm.processor & :processor_mask <> 0)
UPDATE plugins SET enabled = :enabled WHERE plugin_id = :plugin_id
UPDATE plugin_domains SET relpath = :relpath WHERE module_id = :module_id AND id = :id

UPDATE plugin_modules SET scanstate = 2 WHERE scanstate IN (0, 4) AND module_ID IN (SELECT module_id FROM plugins WHERE scanstate IN (2, 3) EXCEPT SELECT module_id FROM plugins WHERE scanstate IN (1, 0)) AND processor & :processor_mask <> 0
UPDATE plugin_modules SET fingerprint = :fingerprint, scanstate = 0 WHERE module_id = :module_id
UPDATE plugin_modules SET scanstate = :scanstate WHERE module_id = :module_id

UPDATE plugin_modules SET scanstate = 4 WHERE module_id IN (SELECT module_id FROM plugin_modules WHERE scanstate = 0 LIMIT 1) AND module_id NOT IN (SELECT module_id FROM plugins) AND processor & :processor_mask <> 0

UPDATE plugins SET scanstate = 4 WHERE plugin_id IN (SELECT plugin_id FROM plugins WHERE scanstate = 0 AND module_id IN (SELECT module_id FROM plugin_modules WHERE processor & :processor_mask <> 0) LIMIT 1)
UPDATE plugin_modules SET scanstate = 2 WHERE scanstate = 4 AND module_id NOT IN (SELECT module_id FROM plugins) AND processor & :processor_mask <> 0
UPDATE plugins SET scanstate = 2 WHERE scanstate = 4 AND module_id IN (SELECT module_id FROM plugin_modules WHERE processor & :processor_mask <> 0)
DELETE FROM plugin_modules

CREATE TABLE plugin_domains ( id TEXT, module_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, relpath TEXT, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0 ); CREATE TABLE plugin_modules ( module_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, path TEXT, arch INTEGER DEFAULT 0, processor INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, fingerprint TEXT ); CREATE TABLE plugins ( plugin_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, module_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, dev_identifier TEXT, name TEXT, vendor TEXT, version TEXT, sdk_version TEXT, flags INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scanstate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, subcategories TEXT, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );
